### (2c) Window — end the stage where the contour departs the frame (slope threshold, global rule, all seven)

Walking outward from x = 0, the stage ends at the last line before the selected contour steps more than slope × 10 m shore-normal between adjacent lines, i.e. before it has turned more than atan(slope) from the stage tangent.
